dedupe_keys.name: graz solar thermal collector array operating data and uncertainty 2017

description: This archive provides one-minute operating data for a 516-square-metre flat-plate solar collector array feeding district heating in Graz, Austria, during 2017. AEE INTEC and SOLID prepared measured and calculated channels with propagated uncertainty; the data owner is solar.nahwaerme.at. The main collection contains fifty-three channels in CSV and Parquet, JSON plant and channel metadata, and Python processing and plotting scripts. Public access is free. Zenodo currently states CC BY 4.0, while the describing article states CC BY-SA 4.0; both assertions are preserved for reuse review. The article reports 8.2 percent missing data, and coverage remains one array for one year. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating collector dynamics, checking irradiance transformations or testing thermal-output forecasts in simulations. model-pypsa provides related energy-system modelling, but no plant-model coupling was checked. The GitLab companion maintains processing code within this same dataset resource.
licence: CC-BY-4.0 in repository metadata; article states CC-BY-SA-4.0
